name: Auto-pause risky Instantly sending accounts and report deliverability to Slack

parameters.content:
## Auto-pause risky Instantly sending accounts and report deliverability to Slack

### How it works

This workflow runs every morning to evaluate Instantly sending accounts for deliverability risk. It pulls account data, checks warmup health, DNS status, and bounce statistics, then scores each account. Risky accounts are automatically paused in Instantly, alerts and a daily digest are sent to Slack, and account health history is logged to Google Sheets.

### Setup steps

- Configure the schedule trigger for the desired daily run time and timezone.
- Add Instantly API credentials to all HTTP Request nodes that call the Instantly API.
- Set the threshold values for bounce rate, minimum sent volume, lookback days, and warmup-score warning level in the Set thresholds node.
- Connect Slack credentials and choose the channels for paused-account alerts and the daily digest.
- Connect Google Sheets credentials and select the spreadsheet/sheet used for the health history log.

### Customization

Adjust the scoring logic and pause criteria to match your deliverability policy, and modify the Slack message formats or Google Sheets columns as needed.

## Schedule risk thresholds

Starts the workflow on a morning schedule and defines the deliverability thresholds used later for scoring and pause decisions.

## Fetch account batches

Retrieves sending accounts from Instantly and flattens/splits the returned account list into batches for bulk health checks.

## Collect health signals

Calls Instantly endpoints to gather warmup health, DNS record status, and bounce statistics for the prepared account batches.

## Score account risk

Combines the collected deliverability signals into a verdict for each account and fans results out to pause, reporting, and logging paths.

## Pause risky accounts

Filters accounts that meet the pause criteria, pauses them in Instantly, and sends an immediate Slack alert for each paused account.

## Send daily digest

Builds a workspace-level Slack summary of account health and sends the daily deliverability digest.

## Log health history

Formats each scored account into a health-history row and appends it to Google Sheets for ongoing tracking.
